en.name: Pastor Jeff
en.title: A Young Pastor from China
en.preview: At a very young age, God called me out of darkness into an extraordinary journey. I was born into an environment heavily entrenched in idolatry and folk superstitions. My father was a fortune-teller, and growing up, I witnessed firsthand many supernatural occurrences that defied human reason—manifestations of dark spiritual realms. Yet, during my university years, I heard the undeniable calling of God to serve Him full-time.
en.verse: "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness."

zh.name: 杰夫牧师
zh.title: 一位来自中国的年轻牧师
zh.preview: 在我很年轻的时候，神便将我从一条完全不寻常的道路上召引出来。我出生在一个充满了偶像崇拜与民间迷信的环境里。我的父亲曾是一名算命先生，在我的成长过程中，我亲眼见证过许多超乎人类理性、却属于黑暗权势的所谓「神迹」。然而，在大学期间，我听到了万军之耶和华对我清晰的呼召——祂要我放下一切，全职服侍祂。
zh.verse: 「我的恩典够你用的，因为我的能力是在人的软弱上显得完全。」
